cohort: 178 pregnant women at Mater Mothers' Hospital, Brisbane, Australia
finding: Women with an Epworth Sleepiness Scale score ≥11 were less likely to have a spontaneous vaginal delivery and more likely to have an operative birth, particularly due to intrapartum fetal compromise, and their infants were more likely to have poor neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with an Epworth Sleepiness Scale score ≥11 were less likely to achieve a spontaneous vaginal delivery and were more likely to have an instrumental or any operative birth.
